videos.title: 404 Bon Blondes – Bewitched
videos.description:
Bewitched is a dark disco rock Halloween flirtation wrapped in velvet, neon and bad(?) intentions.
  
Set against a crooked carnival night of ferris wheels, moonlight and mischief, the song follows a witch who knows exactly what she’s doing.

Sweet enough to draw you closer, dangerous enough to make sure you don’t leave.  

She might be the sweetest trick on the street.
Or the treat.  

Lyrics
[Intro]
Step right up, handsome
Don't look so frightened
It's Halloween after all
Come closer

[Verse 1]
Velvet hat tilted low
Ferris wheel spins below
You freeze right in your tracks
No turning back
Careful, boy, I bite
On this delicious autumn night

[Chorus]
I'm the sweetest trick or treat
Right here on this crooked street
A little spice, a little sweet
Step into my trap complete

[Verse 2]
They say I'm a wicked witch
With a velvet, flirtatious twitch
My broomstick is parked outside
Ready for a wild ride
You look so pale and sweet
My favorite flavor of meat

[Chorus]
I'm the sweetest trick or treat
Right here on this crooked street
A little spice, a little sweet
Step into my trap complete

[Bridge]
Why are your knees shaking, boy
I'm just playing with my toy
Give me your heart on a platter
Nothing else seems to matter

[Chorus]
I'm the sweetest trick or treat
Right here on this crooked street
A little spice, a little sweet
Step into my trap complete
I'm the sweetest trick or treat
Right here on this crooked street
A little spice, a little sweet
Step into my trap complete

[Outro]
Midnight strikes, the spirits call
I was the sweet treat after all
No room to run, no second guess
You fell right into my web, I confess
Gotcha...
I hope I didn't scare you off

videos.title: 404 Bon Blondes – Break the Frame
videos.description:
404 Bon Blondes – Break the Frame

Imagine waking up to a roaring engine.

Then the piercing sound of: Meep-meep.

The door flies open.
The car screeches to a halt.
You’re thrown out onto the tarmac.

Get up.
Keep running.
Break the frame.

Fade to black.

videos.title: 404 Bon Blondes – Façade
videos.description:
Paradise looks convincing from a distance. Up close, the veneer starts to crack.
Façade is what’s left when the smile stops working and the truth finally shows through.

[Verse 1]
You sold the cure in a plastic jar
Promised the moon and the furthest star
Took all the silver and left the lead
Swallowed the poison you tried to spread  

[Pre-Chorus]
Yeah, you wore that grin like a cheap veneer
Now I see the truth and the path is clear  

[Chorus]
This must be just like paradise
At least as long as you don't look twice
Yeah, this must be just like paradise
At least as long as you don't look twice  

[Verse 2]
Scratch at the surface, it’s rotten bone
Building a kingdom on shifting stone
Your holy gospel is built on greed
Feeding the mouth of a different breed  

[Pre-Chorus]
Yeah, you wore that grin like a cheap veneer
Now I see the truth and the path is clear  

[Chorus]
This must be just like paradise
At least as long as you don't look twice
Yeah, this must be just like paradise
At least as long as you don't look twice  

[Bridge]
Keep the change and keep the change of heart
I’m tearing your little world apart
You can rot in the mess you made
I’m done with the games that you played  

[Guitar Solo]

[Final Chorus / Outro]
This must be just like paradise!
Don't you ever look twice! (Don't you ever look twice!)
Yeah, it’s a burning hell once you get there!
This must be just like paradise!
Yeah, you never looked twice!
Just don't look twice!
No, you never looked twice!

videos.title: 404 Bon Blondes – The Silk Road [Instrumental]
videos.description:
The Silk Road

For almost two millennia, the Silk Roads connected East and West through a vast network of trade routes stretching across Asia. Through the mountains and valleys of what is now Kyrgyzstan, caravans carried far more than silk. Goods, ideas, religions, technologies and cultures travelled with them, leaving traces that can still be found across Central Asia.

The great Tianshan mountain corridors formed part of this world, linking settlements, travellers and trading centres across some of the most spectacular and unforgiving landscapes on the ancient routes.

"The Silk Road" is a musical journey into that world, driven forward by rhythm, melody and echoes of Central Asia.

Close your eyes and let the ships of the desert sway beneath you as the road winds through the mountains and disappears beyond the horizon.

#TheSilkRoad #Instrumental #Eurodance #CentralAsia #Kyrgyzstan #404BonBlondes #aimusic
